change: Finite PCM transport supports absolute frame seek across configured full-clip repetitions, clamping at total end and allowing backward seek.
Bevy/Rodio decoder try_seek implements duration-to-frame transport, clears readahead and preserves current channel.
validation: Core6 and client8 tests PASS. Actual PCM transport includes31 ambient media; decoder seek preserves channel phase and discards read-ahead.
limits: This is PCM device transport, not qualification of native Wwise event seek policy.
Native negative milliseconds, nearest markers, partial loops, voice/node dispatch and sample offset conversion remain upstream work.
No new normal executable or audible runtime acceptance.
